newsitem.title: CHINA: China summer 1997 grain crop may rise by 2.5 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China summer 1997 grain crop may rise by 2.5 mln T.

text.p: China's summer grain output in 1997 is forecast to increase by at least 1.5 million tonnes and may climb by as much as 2.5 million tonnes, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
Land under summer grain would reach 31.38 million hectares next year, Xinhua said.
China's summer grain harvest was more than 110 million tonnes this year, up 3.0 percent from last year, while early rice output rose 4.2 percent to 44 million tonnes, local media has said.
China's grain harvest could reach nearly 480 million tonnes in 1996, beating 1995's record output by about 15 million tonnes, it said.
Xinhua said next year's rapeseed harvest was seen growing by 200,000 tonnes to 8.8 million tonnes.
